description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a press conference alongside local leaders and law enforcement leaders to discuss how Roy Cooper’s soft on crime agenda endangered our communities and hurt our families. The law enforcement officers also detailed why some of the largest law enforcement organizations in North Carolina are supporting Whatley over Cooper.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley and Law Enforcement Officials Call Out Governor Cooper’s Extensive Soft-on-Crime Record in Alamance County – Michael Whatley for Senate
